about: Arp Magic's page data for tools/build_packs.py: the pack's line, the families the page filters by, each sound (its file and clip name, family and one line), and the credits. PLACEHOLDER: the round 6 roster of 23 November 2026 (RM INK documentation/arp-demo-pack-plan.md, research/arp-demo-pack-2026-11-22/patches/order.json and kits/SOURCES.md), in the owner's order. Replace with the final roster when the pack lands.
draft: Draft for review. The sounds, demos and sizes are round 6 placeholders (23 November 2026), not the final pack.
line: Keys, plucks, bells, winds and voices, each sound playing an arpeggio idiom, from a Bach prelude to a gamelan interlock.
more: Most are recorded instruments: pianos, mallets, harps, guitars, guzheng, flutes and choir.

sounds.name: Handpan Cycle
sounds.line: A hang in D minor as a handpan groove: the ding, then the tone field, call and answer.

sounds.name: Ocarina Song
sounds.line: A breathy ocarina in a slow song figure: legato for three bars, detached in the fourth.

sounds.name: Romanza Guitar
sounds.line: INK's nylon guitar on Giuliani's right-hand formulas: p-a-m-i, answered by p-i-m-a.

sounds.name: Orinoco Pizz
sounds.line: Cello pizzicato as an Enya ostinato, eighth-note echoes across a big hall.

sounds.name: Whisper Lyre
sounds.line: A ten-string lyre in harp bisbigliando: the chord whispered between the hands at 32nds.

sounds.name: Bright Gliss
sounds.line: Concert harp glissandi: eight notes swept up the chord four times a bar, every string ringing.

sounds.name: Osiris Nocturne
sounds.line: An upright piano nocturne: root and fifth below, the top ringing over a moving inner voice.

sounds.name: Pedal Waterfall
sounds.line: A Steinway grand in the waterfall: the bass, then eight notes falling from the top, under the pedal.

sounds.name: Tenth Lullaby
sounds.line: A soft upright in the Yiruma tenth: bass, fifth, tenth and back, one wave a bar, pedalled.

sounds.name: Gate Pluck
sounds.line: A supersaw trance arp: the chord in 16ths, an octave higher each beat, four octaves a bar.

sounds.name: Pixel Run
sounds.line: A square chip voice flicking five notes up and back at 32nds.

sounds.name: Horn Call
sounds.line: A French horn calling the triad up and back, slurred, then tongued.

sounds.name: Tine Bloom
sounds.line: A tine electric piano in a ballad spread: bass and top, then out from the middle, all held.

sounds.name: Khim Tremolo
sounds.line: A Thai khim's tremolo on the tune's note while the thumb climbs the chord beneath.

sounds.name: Starfall Glock
sounds.line: Orchestra bells under soft mallets: one Lydian cascade a bar, as in a film score.

sounds.name: Neo-Soul Rhodes
sounds.line: A Mark I Rhodes ballad: the bass low, rolled chord tones wandering over it.

sounds.name: Kumbengo
sounds.line: A bright harp in the kora's kumbengo: thumbs on the bass, fingers above.

sounds.name: Rootless Vibes
sounds.line: Vibraphone in Bill Evans voicings, open and damped by turns.

sounds.name: Prelude Marimba
sounds.line: A full marimba on the figure of Bach's Prelude in C, echoes bouncing left and right.

sounds.name: Glass Adagio
sounds.line: Tuned glasses after Mozart's Adagio for glass harmonica: one slow arch a bar, left ringing.

sounds.name: Dayvan Tape
sounds.line: A warm synth on worn tape in a Boards of Canada arp, with long echoes.

sounds.name: Toccata Clav
sounds.line: A clavinet toccata: the bass struck between every note of a rising line.

sounds.name: Rokudan Shirabe
sounds.line: A taishogoto in koto danmono figures: the top ringing, the inner voice walking.

sounds.name: Drumming Wood
sounds.line: Soft-mallet marimba in a Reich build-up: the rests of the grid fill in, bar by bar.

sounds.name: Delay Spires
sounds.line: A clean Gretsch electric: straight 8ths into a dotted-eighth echo.

sounds.name: Fishing Boat Glissandi
sounds.line: Guzheng cascades from Fishing Boat Song at Dusk, falling, then rising.

sounds.name: Choir Entries
sounds.line: An SATB choir entering voice by voice from the bass up: four, then eight.

sounds.name: Additive Organ
sounds.line: A Renaissance chamber organ in a toccata: a pedal point under a rising, then falling hand.

sounds.name: Sikuri Hocket
sounds.line: Two Andean pan flutes trading notes in hocket.

sounds.name: Kotekan
sounds.line: Balinese gamelan bronzes in kotekan interlock.

sounds.name: Sugar Plum Cascade
sounds.line: Celesta cascades after the Sugar Plum Fairy, doubling in speed into each cadence.

sounds.name: Silver Flute
sounds.line: One flute in Ravel's daybreak murmurs, thinning and returning.

sounds.name: Harp Arabesque
sounds.line: Pedal harp in Debussy's first Arabesque: groups of three over the 16ths.

sounds.name: Fox Night
sounds.line: Felt and glass cells after Elijah Fox, growing from six notes to eight.
